title: feat(app-shell): Form tab Preview renders the draft definition, with a Draft preview chip and a Draft / Published toggle (objectui#12515)
body:
Fixes #12515
Clause-②: no

## What changed

**Target 1: Preview renders the draft definition.** The Data pillar's Form tab, Preview mode (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `DataPillar`), mounts the same runtime `ObjectForm` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`, unchanged) the app's record form uses. That renderer takes an object's definition only through `dataSource.getObjectSchema(name)`, and has no inline-schema prop. So Preview now hands it a data source, `formPreviewSource`, whose `getObjectSchema` answers the open object from the pillar's buffer `objDraft`: the draft as served, plus edits not yet saved. Every other read goes to the real adapter. It is not a second renderer, and no server change is needed, so the fork in target 3 does not arise. A draft-only object previews its fields instead of "No published definition yet". A "Draft preview" chip in the Form toolbar (`data-testid` `form-preview-draft-chip`) says which definition is on screen.

**Target 2: Draft / Published toggle; the banner retires.** When the object has a published version and the draft differs from it (a pending draft or an unsaved edit), a Draft / Published toggle (`form-preview-source`) sits next to the chip. Published renders the adapter's definition with the published definition's own field list. A field the draft removed still shows there, and one it added does not. With no published version there is no toggle. A published object with no pending change shows neither chip nor toggle. The yellow banner and the empty state are gone.

**Constraint: Preview never saves.** The preview data source refuses `create`, `update`, `delete`, `bulk`, `bulkUpdate` and `bulkDelete` on both sides of the toggle.

**i18n** (`metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, en and zh, the file's two tables): retired `engine.studio.data.form.previewWarn`, `noPublishedTitle` and `noPublishedHint`. Added `draftChip`, `draftChipTitle`, `sourceLabel`, `sourceDraft` and `sourcePublished`. The Preview button's title `previewBadge` keeps its key; its copy no longer says the preview shows the published version.

Existing `data-testid`s are unchanged. `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx` is unchanged: its `FormToolbar` already takes the hint slot used here.

## Deviations

- One 404 remains in the unpublished Preview, from a lookup field, not from the form: `LookupField` reads its target's definition (`GET /meta/object/st_project`) to derive picker columns. For a draft-only target that read is a 404. The widget drops it silently and renders an empty picker, and the picker is inert in Preview. Answering other draft-only objects' definitions too would widen the card past "the draft object"; it is reported, not built.
- The Preview's existing inline `style` element (the click-to-select CSS) predates this card and is unchanged.
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite was not run locally; the card's acceptance names `DataPillar.*`. All `DataPillar.*` files and all `StudioDesignSurface.*` files ran in full (below). CI runs the whole package.

## Screenshots

1280 x 860, HotCRM `63db83e` under `objectstack dev --fresh`, a writable local package `com.default.studio-test` (namespace `st`). `st_ticket` is draft-only with three draft fields (Subject, Priority, Project). `st_asset` is published with two fields, and its draft adds Warranty Ends. Committed on the evidence branch `claude/issue-12515-evidence` only.

## Requests: the unpublished Preview, before and after

The same Playwright drive on main and on the branch: open the Data pillar, select Ticket, Form, Preview. Full logs: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/4b1b3222035d776048d438cfa3e46e8e17f7ff42/docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/12515/before-light-requests.txt?raw=true and https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/4b1b3222035d776048d438cfa3e46e8e17f7ff42/docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/12515/after-light-requests.txt?raw=true.

- Before (main `572bbce`): the Preview sent no request. It never mounted the form, and drew "No published definition yet".
- After: no request for `st_ticket`; its definition comes from the buffer. The other reads in the segment are the pillar's package re-reads (`/packages`, `/meta`, the object and draft lists, `/meta/app`). They appear in the same position in main's log for the published object's Preview, so they are not the form's. The one 404 is `GET /api/v1/meta/object/st_project`, the lookup target read under Deviations. It stays the same with `st_project` saved as a draft-only object: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/4b1b3222035d776048d438cfa3e46e8e17f7ff42/docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/12515/after-projdraft-light-requests.txt?raw=true.

## Test evidence (at `0e09c1b`)

New: `DataPillar.formDraftPreview-12515.test.tsx`. It uses a real `MetadataClient` over an in-memory server and the real `ObjectForm`.

- A draft-only object with three draft fields shows the three fields, with the chip and no toggle. The adapter is never asked for its definition, and no request answers 400 or above (card acceptance 1).
- A published object with a pending change (a field added, one removed) shows the draft. The toggle's Published side shows the published fields and drops the chip, and back on Draft the draft shows again.
- CONTROL: a published object with no pending change has neither chip nor toggle.
- Preview never saves: a submitted preview form reaches no write.

Ablations (the mutation landed and was checked on disk with `ablation-replace.mjs`; red observed; restored; `git diff HEAD` empty after each):

- Draft answering disabled: 3 of 4 red.
- Write refusal disabled: the never-saves pin red, `expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times`.
- Published field list replaced by the draft's: the toggle pin red. On the first fixture, where the draft only added a field, this ablation stayed green: `ObjectForm` skips names its schema lacks. The fixture's draft now also removes a field.

Runs (repo-root vitest spelling, through the shared verification lock), all exit 0:

- `DataPillar.*` (21 files, 87 tests): card acceptance 3.
- `StudioDesignSurface.*` in three parts: 25 files/118 tests, 27 files/169 tests, 28 files/263 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` after the dependency build (turbo, 28/28): exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test (`--listFiles`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`: exit 0, dist completeness verified.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source and test files: 0 errors. The new test and `i18n.ts` add no warnings, and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` has the same warnings as on main.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` and `check:test-path-roots`, plus `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: all exit 0.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12515-form-draft-preview.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- A lookup to a draft-only object sends one `GET /meta/object/NAME` 404 from `LookupField` in the Preview (see Deviations). No visible defect: an empty picker, no error. Carrier: none.
